lore.tag: 九派浔阳 · 赣北门户
lore.desc: 古称柴桑、寻阳（浔阳）、江州，背倚庐山、北临长江、东控鄱阳湖口，号“众水汇集、九派浔阳”。三国周瑜驻水军于柴桑，东晋至宋元置江州（陶渊明归隐、白居易《琵琶行》及《水浒》浔阳楼所在）。
lore.tagEn: Middle–Lower Yangtze Throat · Northern Gate of Jiangxi
lore.descEn: Backed by Mount Lu where Poyang Lake empties into the Yangtze River, Jiujiang (Chaisang / Xunyang / Jiangzhou) was Zhou Yu's naval base, Tao Yuanming's homeland, and the setting of Bai Juyi's Pipa Song.
